## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the narrowest stable contract and relevant failure cases.
- [ ] Provider capabilities are declared conservatively.
- [ ] Runtime-owned actions are not presented as Ground-approved actions.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated for user-visible behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, transcripts, private paths, local state, or generated releases are included.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior includes a threat statement and residual risk.
